text:
maria: Quick check — seeing inconsistent request IDs surfaced in the Python SDK when we map API errors to exceptions. Also unclear semantics for streaming reconnect/resume. Anybody available to triage?

sam: Which python SDK version and an example log would help.

maria: py sdk 0.12.3. here's a snippet from a failing request:
```
ERROR 2024-05-10 14:22:11 client.py:204 Request failed: 503 Service Unavailable
  body: {"error":"timeout"}
  headers: {"date":"Fri, 10 May 2024 14:22:11 GMT", "x-request-id":"abc123", "content-type":"application/json"}
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "app.py", line 88, in handle
    resp = client.generate(...)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/site-packages/redwood/client.py", line 150, in generate
    raise APIError(status=503, message=... )
APIError: 503 Service Unavailable
```

maria: Note the log shows x-request-id in headers but the raised APIError has no request_id attribute for our app to log. we end up losing the trace id in error reports.

sam: yep that matches a bug I saw. current exception type only stores status/message. we should attach any request id headers into the exception instance (e.g., `exc.request_id`).

kevin: Agreed. Small proposal: map common response headers (`x-request-id`, `x-rid`, `x-correlation-id`) into Exception.request_id (pick first present). Also preserve raw headers on `APIError.raw_headers` for debug. simple change in http client wrapper.

ana: fyi in Go we already return `(*Response).RequestID()` on error paths — parity would be nice.

ana: also recommend we normalize to `request_id` field name across SDKs so Sentry tagging is consistent.

sam: sample python change I have in mind:
```python
class APIError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, status, message, headers=None):
        super().__init__(message)
        self.status = status
        self.raw_headers = headers or {}
        self.request_id = headers.get("x-request-id") or headers.get("x-rid") or headers.get("x-correlation-id")

# and in http wrapper
if resp.status_code >= 400:
    raise APIError(resp.status_code, resp.text, resp.headers)
```

maria: perfect — can we also ensure logger includes `request_id` automatically in debug logs? right now our structured logs are missing it in a few places.

kevin: yes, add a logger filter or include via `extra={'request_id': exc.request_id}` when logging exceptions. For structlog/structlog-like flows we can set a context var at request start `bind(request_id=resp.headers.get(...))` for sync calls.

ana: streaming note: when a stream disconnects we emit `StreamInterrupted` with `resume_token` available in some models. need to document that SDK will include `resume_token` on the exception and allow `resume_from(token)` on the client. current Python client returns simple `StreamClosedError` with no token.

sam: yes — for resumable streams we should:
- include `resume_token` and `last_event_id` on the exception
- provide `client.resume_stream(resume_token)` helper
- surface `is_transient` boolean on error so callers can decide retry vs fail

maria: tests to add: header-to-exc mapping, logger context propagation, streaming resume token roundtrip. also update CHANGELOG + migration note.

kevin: I'll open a draft PR against `sdks/python` with tests. cc @sam for review. want minimal public API change (attach attrs but keep message/str the same).

ci-bot: PR #4124 opened: sdks/python: attach request_id + resume_token to exceptions — builds queued.

maria: thanks! one more ask — for users who forget to log `exc.request_id`, can we add request_id to the exception `__str__`? e.g. `503 Service Unavailable (request_id=abc123)` so it appears in plain text logs.

sam: sounds fine; include only when present to avoid noise.

kevin: will include that and a tiny docs blurb under "Error handling" in the client reference: how to read `request_id` and `resume_token`.

maria: awesome. followups: kevin will get PR, sam will review and add tests, ana will confirm Go parity later this week. tagging this as a devex backlog item so docs people can update examples. :thumbsup:

kevin: PR ready for review — pls ping if you need quick changes.

sam: reviewing now, found one nit about header casing; will push fix.

ci-bot: PR #4124 build passed, tests 78 passed, 2 skipped.

maria: thanks team — closing thread after merge. if anyone sees a production reproducible after merge ping here with logs. :rocket:
